item.title: Sydney gardener fined $187,500 for unlawful tree removal
item.description:
A gardener has been fined nearly $200,000 for the destruction of 287 native trees in protected Sydney bushland. The incident, described as environmental vandalism, involved felling trees to improve views for a harbourside mansion.
